Folks — reviewed Alex's notes and the attachments. A few product-marketing-specific suggestions before the PM sync: 

1) Hero blurb: remove the phrase "enterprise-grade" unless we can attach a performance claim (latency/throughput). Suggest: "Low-latency inference for production apps — deploy on-demand, pay for usage."
2) Tile naming: avoid 'Starter' (sounds trialy); propose 'Developer', 'Business', 'Enterprise' — maps better to persona-based messaging.
3) Entitlement table: we should expose burst capacity and SLA tiers explicitly as bullet points under each tile to reduce procurement Qs.
4) Footnote language: for the data residency requirement Alex specified, add "US-only data processing available via Private Deployment" and link to our private offering page.

I updated tile-taxonomy-v3.xlsx with the suggested names and added a short copy doc in tab 'copy_notes'. Will re-upload final after PM call.
